company_source_label: Karuna Therapeutics, a Bristol Myers Squibb company
evidence_basis: Public documents reviewed now; not a point-in-time backtest or a current company recommendation.
extraction_method: Manual structured extraction from web-rendered FDA/BMS sources; FDA label tables visually cross-checked.

sources.title: FDA original prescribing information
sources.locator: Table 4, PDF page 22; Table 1, PDF page 8
sources.scope: Original approval label, not a current prescribing recommendation.
sources.inspected_by: web text and rendered PDF tables

sources.title: FDA drug-trials snapshot
sources.scope: Summary text contains a safety-population wording discrepancy; the label/table denominators are retained.

sources.title: BMS full-year 2024 results
sources.locator: Full-year product revenue table: Cobenfy and Total Revenues; units USD millions
sources.scope: Historical reported sales, not a current revenue estimate or independently audited statement read in this specimen.

clinical.design: Two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, five-week studies
clinical.endpoint: Change from baseline in PANSS total score at week 5

safety.population: Pooled safety population in the two five-week controlled trials
safety.selection_note: Three selected adverse reactions, not a complete safety review; rounded percentages do not identify exact event counts.

judgments.why: Both placebo-adjusted confidence intervals fall below zero on the same symptom endpoint.
judgments.limit: This does not establish a new-trial success probability or superiority to an active antipsychotic.

judgments.read: Five-week benefit is not a lifetime outcome.
judgments.why: The displayed controlled efficacy comparison is short-term; long-term persistence, tolerability and real-world use need separate analysis.
judgments.limit: Other longer-term data exist outside these two controlled comparisons; this is not a claim that no long-term evidence exists.

judgments.read: Approval and early sales do not price the stock.
judgments.why: The reported launch-period sales need a forward adoption, net-price, margin and whole-company valuation model.
judgments.limit: The small historical revenue share is not a cap on future value or a stock-return prediction.

source_discrepancy.affected_claim: The FDA snapshot narrative describes the 504-person safety population as receiving COBENFY.
source_discrepancy.table_supported_resolution: The original label and both safety tables divide 504 as 251 COBENFY and 253 placebo.
source_discrepancy.action: Use the specific label/table denominators for this specimen and preserve the conflicting prose for producer review. Do not silently rewrite the source.

investment.reason: Historical outcome known; prospective model, price, full company economics and accepted policy not supplied.
